title: Higher direct images of quasi-coherent sheaves vanish past degree one for proper maps with at-most-curve fibres, and the first direct image vanishes for globally generated sheaves

standard_prerequisites.use: The dimension-bound on cohomological amplitude (Limits, lemma-higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre), the chapter's lemma-h1-fibre-zero, quasi-coherence of higher direct images, and colimit commutation for H^1 on quasi-separated schemes.

core_obligations: Bound direct images by the fibre dimension.
Reduce relative vanishing to the affine global statement.
Kill H^1 of globally generated sheaves by free resolutions and the long exact sequence.

proof_roadmap.step: Amplitude bound plus H^1(O) vanishing seeds the induction.
Direct-sum commutation finishes the globally generated case.

difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y whose fibres have dimension at most 1 and satisfy H^1 of the structure sheaf equal to zero everywhere, the lemma shows R^p f_* F is zero for p > 1 for any quasi-coherent F, R^1 f_* F vanishes when F is a quotient of the pullback of a quasi-coherent sheaf on Y, and over affine Y the global groups vanish in all degrees except 0 and 1 with H^1 vanishing for globally generated F. The retained proof is written: the degree bound is Limits, lemma-higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre; reduction (2) to (4) uses quasi-coherence of higher direct images on affine bases (Cohomology of Schemes, lemmas quasi-coherence-higher-direct-images and its application); (4) itself takes a surjection from a free direct sum, uses the long exact sequence together with part (1) to push surjectivity onto H^1, the vanishing H^1(X, O_X) from lemma-h1-fibre-zero, and commutation of H^1 with direct sums (Cohomology, lemma-quasi-separated-cohomology-colimit). Retained author proof at lines 20988-21015.
